info.name: Pioneer XDJ-700 / XDJ-1000
info.author: Mixxx Android
info.description: Pioneer XDJ-700 and XDJ-1000 in USB MIDI mode (LINK: CONTROL MODE, USB MIDI). One or two units: each plays the deck of its MIDI channel, or the deck chosen in the settings. Messages from the manuals of the XDJ-700 and XDJ-1000.

option.label: Deck of this unit

value.label: By its MIDI channel (1 = deck 1, 2 = deck 2...)

option.description: With two units: set MIDI channel 2 on the second one (UTILITY), or choose Deck 1 here for one unit and Deck 2 for the other.

value.label: CDJ: the platter bends the tempo
